blocks.content: Like AVL trees, we can generalize inserting elements into a red-black tree into the following steps:

items: Insert the element like you would in a BST.
Mark the new insertion as red.
Check if any of the properties of RBT are violated.
Apply rotation and/or change color to restore the balance.
